invariants.rationale: The method always returns a HoodieWriteMetadata object, constructed via execute() of JavaDeleteDeltaCommitActionExecutor.
A valid HoodieWriteMetadata should contain a list of WriteStatus, which should not be null.
The return type ensures that getWriteStatuses returns a List implementation.
The method expects a non-null list of hoodie keys to process deletes.
An instant time is required for commit actions, so it should not be null at method exit.
